# Geometric Linear Algebra — Spaces and Projections

Book Chapter 4 relates points, lines, planes, projections, vector spaces and bases. Geometry turns symbols into directions you can imagine.

## Follow the chapters

1. [lines planes and span](01-lines-planes-and-span.qmd)
2. [projections](02-projections.qmd)
3. [basis and dimension](03-basis-and-dimension.qmd)

Start from the first one. Read the mathematical statement aloud, name every symbol, put numbers into it, and explain **why** it works.

**Textbook structure:** Ivan Savov, *No Bullshit Guide to Linear Algebra*, second edition, Geometric Linear Algebra — Spaces and Projections. The PDF supplied was a **preview**; these are original teaching chapters built around its topic map.
